output.reason: The release note says 1.13.0 "changes the defaults to disable the policy exceptions" [ev-2bd1a74f9c4a], and the upgrade guide describes this as a change to the chart's default exception settings [ev-dea2079e5dc4, ev-2bbc505de6bb]. It does not describe a change to the PolicyException CRD schema, so crd-field PolicyException spec with behavior-changed names the wrong subject and the wrong change type. The chart-default renders show this flag going from --enablePolicyException=true to --enablePolicyException=false on the admission, background and reports controllers [ev-b39e8c27b4a6, ev-e599ee1bf192, ev-89fe173dc4ac, ev-87f3f8d70a09, ev-f85ade3c8a00]. That makes it a default-changed from true to false.

correction.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 turns policy exceptions off by default (CVE-2024-48921 hardening). The chart-rendered default of --enablePolicyException on the admission, background and reports controllers changes from true to false.
